newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH OTC MARKET CLEARS POLISA SHARES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH OTC MARKET CLEARS POLISA SHARES.

text.p: Poland's over-the-counter market, set to start trade on Friday, has cleared for OTC trade shares insurer TUR Polisa , the president of the company managing the OTC trade said on Thursday.

"The supervisory board of CTO (Centralna Tabela Ofert) has passed a motion on writing in (Polisa) G and K shares...into its register of securities," Czeslaw Gawlowski told Reuters, adding that the 4.3 million shares could start trade by year-end.
Polisa currently has 4.1 million shares trading on the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
On Friday CTO trade gets underway with shares in machine-tool maker Rafamet SA, the first firm to be accepted for trade.

Gawlowski also said about 30 firms in Poland's mass privatisation National Investment Fund (NFI) programme had informed the state treasury of their interest in a CTO listing, which could happen in the second quarter next year.
